Marie-Julie Watson

The Life of the Party

Pronouns She/her, they/them
Species Human
Age Adult
Occupation Investigative journalist, waitress, part-time student
Birthplace Chicago, Illinois, URL
Nicknames & Titles MJ, Muse Clio, Clitoris, Red
Song(s) Bobby James / Vampyre Erotica / Monie in the Middle / Dance for Me / Stephanie / Cherry Bomb

Marie-Julie Watson should get her life together. You know it as much as she does.
Shit's never that simple though, let's be real.

Once upon a time, life used to hinge around hiding and scurrying about, as though she were a mouse. MJ's life used to be full of fear. There's no other word that's so picture-perfect.
Fearing the hand of her father, fearing loving her mother too much for her own good, fearing the roof over her head would cave in once and for all, putting all of them out of their misery. Hiding, avoiding, and hiding again. There was nothing else.

She wishes she could say these early years blurred together into a haze, but MJ's not gonna lie to you. Instead, they still seem to jump out of their respective chapters to gnaw at her mind with blinding clarity.
The weird thing is that the right to be shrouded by impermeable fog was actually reserved for her adulthood; the now. Funny how that works.
Since moving away from that stars-forsaken household in search of a better life — a life true to herself and not gripped day-in-day-out by fear — they've found that misery really does love company. Of course, they hadn't believed the lasting effects would magically disappear after they drove all the way to the East Coast, no, but this aimless, lifeless stupor they're stuck in hits far, far harder than her father ever could.

You know the feeling; you wake up, do what people tell you to do, and — next thing you know — you're vomiting into the nearest toilet in a tight black dress with deafening music blasting from the other room while scared shitless because you abruptly remembered a childhood memory that you were stupid enough to believe you could bury.
A hand is stiffly and awkwardly patting your back, belonging to someone who has your lipstick on their neck, but whose name and visage you can't recall for the life of you. Your bank account is somehow emptier than the day before even though you're trying your hardest.

Rinse and repeat, and you'll have found yourself becoming the perfect party girl. It's really not as hard as people believe.

MJ should be happy. They should be better off than they were in the Midwest, at least.
They're not destined to be some party girl. She's supposed to be independently living her best life surrounded by people who'll support her with every step of the way. She shouldn't be consumed by this stars-damned fear. Her final resting place shouldn't be some random guy's dirty couch.

MJ should get her life together.

Notes

  • MJ's confident. Bold. Outspoken. Very devil-may-care, if you will. Maybe a bit smug?
  • She's also 5'6/167.6 cm.
  • You can put MJ's hair in a poofy low ponytail if you want to put a cool hat on her.
  • They have red dyed streaks in their hair. It doesn't matter how saturated they are or if they're sparkly or something. Go ham.
  • Their voice is velvety smooth.
  • Either a pretentious philosopher wannabe or the most superficial partygoer you've ever met. No in-between.
  • Her fashion sense is survival horror protagonist, 2000s era black streetwear, and Y2K/Y2K futurism. Either one works. Or combine them into something unholy.

General Notes

  • If someone has a darker skintone, do not whitewash them.

  • Don't make muscular characters skinny either.

Trivia

  • Her favorite food is puff-puff with powdered sugar on top.
  • MJ has a black cat named Chére.
  • A firm believer of baked goods tasting better when they're dunked in maple syrup. This isn't exclusive to breakfast foods.
  • The only other permanent member of Ghyslaine's band, Glockamole, either playing the piano or guitar. Sometimes, she's the lead singer.
  • Greatly prefers nonfiction to fictional media, but doesn't mind indulging in the latter at all, especially if it's horror.
  • Kind of unhinged and deranged about history as a subject. Does she like it? Does she hate it? Even MJ herself doesn't know.
  • Reads at least one essay every day like morning newspapers.
  • Also one of those people who will psychoanalyze their friends to hell and back. They have notebooks and documents fully dedicated to picking at their friends' brains to "understand them better." Doesn't tell anyone this for obvious reasons.
  • Scarily aware of current events. Crime, politics, local events, holidays and their histories, how well certain local businesses are faring, etc. If there's something happening, chances are, she knows about it.
  • Harbors a slight unspoken distaste for people who live under a rock.
  • Also scarily accurate in guessing how people are feeling and why.
  • Ironically, she's not very in tune with her own emotions and stifles them, more often than not.
  • Asks strangers and friends alike weirdly personal questions at random — especially at parties — because she enjoys deep, heart-to-heart conversations. Also does this when drunk off her ass.
